theorems.name: Submission.stationary_radial_imrep_weighted_moment_eq_zero
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (R : IMRep (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n), (∀ X : Euclid P → Euclid P, ContDiff ℝ 1 X → HasCompactSupport X → R.firstVariation X = 0) → (∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection x = x) → ∀ (e : Euclid P) (ρ : ℝ), ∫ x, max (ρ ^ 2 - ‖x‖ ^ 2) 0 * inner ℝ e x ∂R.measure = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
